name: Surplus fit opportunity scorecard
author: @T3-ENGINE
rationale: An additive integer point scorecard, hand checkable on a napkin, because the principal must be able to check the arithmetic himself and because in a succession year the business needs the object that IS the decision, not a post hoc explanation of a black box. Every feature traces to a verbatim statement in the corpus. The points do not.

epistemic_status.statement: The points on this card are a PRIOR, not a measurement. No point value here was fitted to an outcome. They encode the relative emphasis the expert places on each signal in his own written words, and they are wrong in ways nobody can currently quantify. Every surface that renders a score must say so.
epistemic_status.refit_precondition: Refit from labelled decisions once resolved outcomes exist. The rule layer stays in front of any learned layer permanently, because it is the fallback when a feature is unavailable and it is the artifact a successor can read.
epistemic_status.calibration_note: The threshold is calibrated to a single on record decision, n equals 1. See threshold.rationale. It is a queue length control, not a cost optimum.

scale.direction: higher is a stronger surplus fit opportunity

threshold.rationale: Set at the point where the expert's own fully enumerated cue set on NSN 4730-00-536-2210, the corpus decision fixture, clears it. That fixture scores 50 exactly on the cues he wrote down. This is a calibration to one on record decision, n equals 1, and it is stated as such rather than dressed as a cost optimum. Brain mapping 7 is the reason: the classification threshold is not the control variable, the queue length is, so this number moves when the operator's daily capacity moves and it carries no claim beyond that.

coverage.rationale: Below four observed core features the card abstains regardless of score. A row can reach the threshold on non core signals alone plus three core signals, and flagging that row would present a surplus thesis while four of its seven thesis features were never seen. The abstention on a high value row is an alert, not a silence.
coverage.abstain_when_unobserved_could_cross_rati: A row that scores below the threshold but whose unobserved features could carry it over is an abstention, not a skip. Calling it a skip asserts a negative the evidence does not support.

counterfactual.tie_break_statement: Fewest features changed wins first. Among changes of equal count, the most actionable feature wins, taken from the ranked actionability list on this card. A single feature flip names the smallest band change that still crosses the threshold, because the useful sentence is the nearest one. A combination names each member at its furthest reachable band.
counterfactual.realistic_combination_rationale: Beyond three simultaneous changes the sentence stops being a counterfactual an operator can act on and becomes a restatement of the whole card. When the minimum is larger than this, the honest answer is to say so and name the count.
counterfactual.changes_only_observed_features_rationale: An unobserved field is a measurement gap, not a value that could have been different. Unobserved fields belong in data_gaps, never in a counterfactual change list.
counterfactual.actionability_rank_rationale: Ordered by how much the operator can actually influence or re acquire the field, most first. Buying the shelf is the most actionable thing this business does, and cornering thin availability is the second. Platform longevity and the depot stocking policy are facts about the world that no operator changes.

reasons.order: absolute points contributed, descending, then card feature order
reasons.order_rationale: A heavy penalty is a principal reason. Ranking by signed points would bury the single strongest argument against a row underneath three weak arguments for it.
reasons.direction_lexicon_rationale: Exactly two words, chosen so the check is unambiguous. A sentence carrying a direction word whose polarity contradicts the sign of its contribution fails the R3.7 gate.
reasons.sentence_numeral_rule: A band sentence may contain no bare digits. Every numeral it renders must arrive through a placeholder that resolves to a field on the emitted reason, so a numeral in generated prose can always be traced back to the payload.

excluded_by_design.why: Not connected. It stays an honest empty state and is never fed from the award frequency inference, and the inference is never presented as a forecast.
Cancelled award supersession is an ETL rule with a date, applied in the load. As a feature it would compute every downstream statistic from data the expert considers void.
Price discovery. It tells you what the thing is worth, not whether you will win. It lives in pricing and never enters the probability estimand.

Third party aggregator vocabulary that appears zero times in primary government text. The expert genuinely uses it, so pricing carries it with that provenance on its face, but a scored signal would launder somebody else's model output into ours.
T2 posted delivery_days_est as ESTIMATED and this lane committed that no shipped score depends on it until it is confirmed against real solicitation PDFs.
Same T2 notice. ESTIMATED, so the preference and the tie breaker that key off it ship disabled with a data gap rather than running on an inferred field.
Structural eligibility runs before scoring as a yes or no gate, never as a negative weight. A high score must never outvote a fact about whether the product can play at all.
Same reason. It is an eligibility emission, not a point deduction.
Same reason. A single character of remarks removes a quote from automated award, which is a gate outcome, not a score adjustment.

cues_present_not_cited.why: The expert reads a LARGE GAP between orders as maintenance opportunities ahead, and separately reads a HIGH award frequency as continued demand. Those are opposite readings of the same measurement, and v0 will not encode a contradiction. Which regime applies needs elicitation, not a weight.

It must be computed from the printed procurement history after the cancelled award supersession rule runs in the load. That loader is not connected, and scoring it from unsuperseded history would compute a monopoly signal from data the expert considers void.
See excluded_by_design for required_delivery_days. The cue is real and the expert states it plainly, but the underlying field is ESTIMATED and this lane committed not to score it yet.
Espoused use of a signal does not upgrade its provenance. Carried in pricing with the aggregator provenance shown, never scored.
An approved source is not automatically a stocking shelf. Turning it into points would read an approval as physical availability, which is a fabricated readiness finding.
No connected source of vendor revenue trajectory exists. Scoring it would require inventing the input.

expert_spans.note: Verbatim from the cited file, with runs of whitespace normalized to a single space and nothing else changed.

features.label: Offers received on the prior solicitation for this stock number
labels: Fewer bidders is a BUY signal on this card, not a risk signal. The expert states the direction himself.

features.resolves_with: numberOfOffersReceived on the prior award in FPDS, which is published free and coded consistently across offices.
